licence.title: Physician Assistant (P.A.) license plus registration to a supervising physician
licence.renewalDeadline: Annually; application received on or before December 31 (license renews January 1). CME is counted over two calendar years.

ce.cyclePeriod: every two calendar years (certified on each annual renewal)
ce.categoryRules: AMA PRA Category 1 or equivalent; AAPA Category I CME, AOA Category 1-A, AAFP Prescribed and ACOG Cognate credits count as equivalent; nationally recognized advanced life support courses count up to 2 credits per course; BLS excluded.
ce.nccpaNote: PANCE passage is required for the initial license (540-X-7-.04); Chapter 540-X-7 renewal and CME rules contain no requirement to hold current NCCPA certification and no NCCPA in lieu provision.

topicMandates.appliesTo: New licensees within 12 months of license issue (effective 2025-01-01); all active PAs licensed before then had a deadline of 2025-12-31
PAs holding a QACSC (AMA PRA Category 1 or equivalent)

topicMandates.topic: Controlled substance prescribing (8 h) plus advanced pharmacology and prescribing trends for controlled substances (4 h)
topicMandates.appliesTo: Before applying for a QACSC, completed within 1 year preceding application

topicMandates.topic: Board of Medical Examiners prescribed CE on Alabama rules and statutes governing supervised practice
topicMandates.appliesTo: Each PA registering to a supervising physician (effective 2024-01-01): completed within 48 months before or 12 months after registration; the rule states no hour count

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 4 AMA PRA Category 1 credits every two years in a Board-approved controlled substance prescribing course to renew a QACSC; 12 hours one-time before a first QACSC.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Registration to a supervising physician is filed with and approved by the Board (application with practice sites, hours and a signed job description that includes the non-controlled formulary). No periodic re-filing rule was found; a new registration agreement is submitted when the supervising physician changes. Quarterly quality assurance by the supervising physician is required.
practice.notes: No independent practice. Remote sites: physician present 10% of scheduled hours for PAs with under 2 years (4,000 hours) in a registration agreement; after that, site visits twice a year and quarterly meetings.

prescribing.stateCsRegistrationName: Qualified Alabama Controlled Substances Registration Certificate (QACSC), Schedules III to V, issued by the Board of Medical Examiners; renewed annually by December 31
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: QACSC renewal: 4 AMA PRA Category 1 credits every 2 years in controlled substance prescribing; current PDMP registration and current DEA registration required to renew the QACSC. Legend drug prescribing is limited to the Board-approved formulary in the job description. A first QACSC also requires 12 months of active practice under Board-approved registration agreements after NCCPA certification (or 3 years supervised practice in any state plus 1 year holding DEA registration).

board.name: Alabama Board of Nursing (collaboration jointly with the Alabama Board of Medical Examiners)

rn.renewalDeadline: December 31 of the expiration year; renewal window September 1 to December 31. Single state RN licenses expire December 31 of even years; Alabama multistate RN licenses expire December 31 of odd years.

topicMandates.topic: Board-provided CE on statutory and administrative frameworks, scope and standards of practice
topicMandates.appliesTo: First license renewal only (counts within the prorated total)

aprn.title: CRNP (Certified Registered Nurse Practitioner)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Certificate of qualification plus Board approval to practice in a specific collaborative practice; approval is renewed with the RN license
aprn.ceNote: No separate APRN hour total: the 6 pharmacology hours are part of the 24 RN contact hours.

topicMandates.topic: Pharmacology specific to prescriptive practice in the approved collaborative practice area
topicMandates.appliesTo: CRNPs with prescriptive authority (not required for the first renewal if one year or less remained in the license period at initial approval)

topicMandates.topic: Board of Nursing prescribed CE on Alabama collaborative practice rules and statutes
topicMandates.appliesTo: Each CRNP, completed within 48 months before or 12 months after commencement of collaborative practice

prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 6 contact hours per 2 year cycle within the 24 hours
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: QACSC holders: 4 AMA PRA Category 1 credits (or equivalent) every two years in a Board-approved controlled substance prescribing course; 12 hours (8 controlled substance prescribing + 4 advanced pharmacology) one-time within 1 year before applying.
prescribing.stateCsRegistrationName: QACSC issued by the Alabama Board of Medical Examiners (Chapter 540-X-18); renewed annually by December 31; requires current DEA and PDMP registration and 12 months of approved collaborative practice before first issue

practice.authorityNote: Label is the conventional classification; the primary rules require a physician collaborative practice agreement with physician presence and quarterly meetings, which is what the label summarises. 610-X-9-.15(1)(a) still refers to an exemption from collaboration under 610-X-5-.07, but 610-X-5-.07 was repealed effective 2026-01-10, so the exemption's current criteria could not be located in the rules.
practice.transitionNote: Not a transition to independent practice: for CRNPs with under 2 years (4,000 hours) of collaborative practice the collaborating physician must be present at least 10% of scheduled hours.
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Collaborative practice (with standard protocol) is approved jointly by the Board of Nursing and the Board of Medical Examiners; the physician files a Commencement of Collaborative Practice form with the BME. Approval continues at each RN renewal on verification of continued collaboration and payment of the advanced practice renewal fee; termination must be reported and ends the approval. Quarterly quality assurance with each CRNP and, after 4,000 hours, quarterly physician meetings; remote sites visited at least twice a year (610-X-5-.09(5)).

unverified: PA: the Alabama PA statute (Code of Ala. 1975, 34-24-290 et seq.) was not loaded; 'NCCPA not required for renewal' rests on rules 540-X-7-.07, .29 and the optional NCCPA question on the renewal form in the 540-X-7 appendix.

NP: 'restricted' practice authority is a classification label; the rules confirm a mandatory physician collaborative practice agreement. The criteria for exemption from collaboration (statute 34-21-80 et seq.; repealed rule 610-X-5-.07) were not located in current rules.
NP and PA: the one-time supervised/collaborative practice CE rules (540-X-7-.16(6), 610-X-9-.14(3)) state no hour count.

No additional topic mandates (opioid, implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, Alzheimer, suicide, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence) were found in 540-X-7, 540-X-12, 540-X-18, 610-X-4-.08, 610-X-5 or 610-X-9 as loaded; the federal one-time 8 hour MATE (DEA) training is federal and not in these rules.

corrections: PA: added missed one-time mandate, BME-prescribed CE on supervised practice rules within 48 months before or 12 months after registration (540-X-7-.16(6)); no hour count in the rule.

PA: added QACSC prerequisite of 12 months registered practice after NCCPA certification (540-X-12-.03(4)) and a separate PDMP fact (540-X-12-.05(4)); the PDMP point was asserted in prose but had no fact.

PA: NCCPA-not-required conclusion strengthened: the PA renewal form in the 540-X-7 appendix asks NCCPA status as an optional yes/no question with a CME attestation of 50 credits over two calendar years; board page loaded and agrees on annual renewal and 50 per 2 years.
